deleted.description: Whether the bot has been deleted.

team_id.description: ID of the workspace the bot belongs to.

updated.description: Unix timestamp of the last profile update.

channel.description: Required. Channel containing the message to be deleted.

Error.description: Slack Web API error response. Returned when `ok` is false (usually with HTTP 200) or with non-2xx status codes such as 429 rate limiting.

errors.description: Additional error details for some errors.

needed.description: For `missing_scope` errors, the OAuth scope(s) that are needed.

provided.description: For `missing_scope` errors, the OAuth scopes the token has.

response_metadata.description: Additional messages that explain the error.

channel.description: ID of the channel containing the message.

permalink.description: HTTP permalink URL of the message.

warning.description: Warning code(s) if the request succeeded with warnings.

app_id.description: ID of the Slack app that posted the message.

attachments.description: Legacy secondary attachments of the message.

blocks.description: Block Kit layout blocks of the message.

bot_id.description: ID of the bot that posted the message.

bot_profile.description: Profile of the bot that posted the message.

metadata.description: Structured metadata attached to the message.

parent_user_id.description: User ID of the author of the thread's parent message.

subtype.description: Message subtype, e.g. `bot_message`. Absent for plain user messages.

team.description: ID of the workspace the message was posted in.

thread_ts.description: Timestamp of the parent message if the message is part of a thread.

ts.description: Timestamp of the message. Unique within the channel and used as the message ID.

type.description: Type of the object, usually `message` (or `delayed_message` for scheduled messages).

user.description: ID of the user who posted the message.

username.description: Custom username the message was posted with.

Message_Icons.description: Icon overrides used when a message was posted with a custom icon.

emoji.description: Emoji code used as the message icon (e.g. `:chart_with_upwards_trend:`).

image_64.description: URL of the image used as the message icon.

Message_Metadata.description: Structured message metadata attached to a message, containing an event type and an event payload.

event_payload.description: A JSON object holding event-specific fields.

event_type.description: A namespaced string that identifies the type of the metadata event.

Post_Ephemeral_Request.description: Request body for chat.postEphemeral. One of `text`, `blocks`, `attachments` or `markdown_text` is required.

as_user.description: (Legacy) Pass true to post the message as the authed user.

attachments.description: A JSON-based array of structured (legacy) attachments.

blocks.description: A JSON-based array of structured Block Kit blocks.

channel.description: Required. Channel, private group, or IM channel to send the message to.

icon_emoji.description: Emoji to use as the icon for this message.

icon_url.description: URL to an image to use as the icon for this message.

link_names.description: Find and link channel names and usernames.

markdown_text.description: Message text formatted in markdown (max 12,000 characters).

parse.description: Change how messages are treated (`none` or `full`).

text.description: Message body, or fallback text when `blocks` are used.

thread_ts.description: Provide another message's `ts` value to post this message in a thread.

user.description: Required. ID of the user who will receive the ephemeral message. The user must be in the channel.

warning.description: Warning code(s) if the request succeeded with warnings.

Post_Message_Request.description: Request body for chat.postMessage. One of `text`, `blocks`, `attachments` or `markdown_text` is required.

as_user.description: (Legacy) Pass true to post the message as the authed user instead of as a bot.

attachments.description: A JSON-based array of structured (legacy) attachments.

blocks.description: A JSON-based array of structured Block Kit blocks.

channel.description: Required. An encoded ID or channel name that represents a channel, private group, or IM channel to send the message to.

icon_emoji.description: Emoji to use as the icon for this message. Overrides `icon_url`.

icon_url.description: URL to an image to use as the icon for this message.

link_names.description: Find and link user groups. No longer supports linking individual users; use the `<@U123>` syntax instead.

markdown_text.description: Accepts message text formatted in markdown (max 12,000 characters). Cannot be used together with `blocks` or `text`.

mrkdwn.description: Disable Slack markup parsing by setting to false. Defaults to true.

parse.description: Change how messages are treated (`none` or `full`).

reply_broadcast.description: Used with `thread_ts`; indicates whether the reply should also be visible to everyone in the channel. Defaults to false.

text.description: How this field works depends on whether `blocks` are used: it is the message body, or the fallback text shown in notifications when blocks are given.

thread_ts.description: Provide another message's `ts` value to make this message a reply. Avoid using a reply's `ts` value; use its parent instead.

unfurl_links.description: Pass true to enable unfurling of primarily text-based content.

unfurl_media.description: Pass false to disable unfurling of media content.

channel.description: ID of the channel the message was posted to.

ts.description: Timestamp ID of the posted message.

warning.description: Warning code(s) if the request succeeded with warnings.

Response_Metadata.description: Additional metadata returned with a Web API response, such as warning/error detail messages and pagination cursors.

messages.description: Detailed messages explaining errors or warnings (e.g. invalid block details).

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page of results. An empty string means there are no more results.

as_user.description: Pass true to post as the authed user instead of as a bot. Defaults to false.

blocks.description: A JSON-based array of structured Block Kit blocks.

channel.description: Required. Channel, private group, or DM channel to send the message to.

markdown_text.description: Message text formatted in markdown (max 12,000 characters).

parse.description: Change how messages are treated (`none` or `full`).

post_at.description: Required. Unix timestamp of the future time the message should be posted (at most 120 days ahead).

reply_broadcast.description: Used with `thread_ts`; make the reply visible to everyone in the channel. Defaults to false.

text.description: Message body, or fallback text when `blocks` are used.

thread_ts.description: Provide another message's `ts` value to make this message a reply.

unfurl_links.description: Pass true to enable unfurling of primarily text-based content.

unfurl_media.description: Pass false to disable unfurling of media content.

channel.description: ID of the channel the message is scheduled for.

post_at.description: Unix timestamp of when the message will be posted.

scheduled_message_id.description: ID of the scheduled message (e.g. `Q1298393284`), used to delete or list it.

warning.description: Warning code(s) if the request succeeded with warnings.

as_user.description: (Legacy) Pass true to update the message as the authed user.

attachments.description: A JSON-based array of structured (legacy) attachments.

blocks.description: A JSON-based array of structured Block Kit blocks. Pass an empty array to clear existing blocks.

channel.description: Required. Channel containing the message to be updated.

file_ids.description: Array of new file IDs that will be sent with this message.

link_names.description: Find and link channel names and usernames.

markdown_text.description: Accepts message text formatted in markdown (max 12,000 characters).

parse.description: Change how messages are treated (`none` or `full`).

reply_broadcast.description: Broadcast an existing thread reply to make it visible to everyone in the channel.

text.description: New message body, or fallback text when `blocks` are used.

channel.description: ID of the channel containing the updated message.

chat.delete.description: Deletes a message from a channel. Requires `chat:write`.

channel.description: The ID of the conversation or channel containing the message.

message_ts.description: A message's `ts` value, uniquely identifying it within a channel.

chat.getPermalink.description: Retrieves a permalink URL for a specific existing message.

chat.postEphemeral.description: Sends an ephemeral message to a user in a channel. Only the given user sees it, and it is not persisted. Requires `chat:write`.

chat.postMessage.description: Sends a message to a channel. Requires the `chat:write` scope. The bot must be a member of the channel unless it has `chat:write.public`. Rate limit: generally 1 message per second per channel.

chat.scheduleMessage.description: Schedules a message to be sent to a channel at a future time. Requires `chat:write`.

chat.update.description: Updates a message in a channel. Requires `chat:write`.
